info.title: SeruendeshAI API
info.description: RAG walking assistant for Astana: 1–3 grounded recommendations with why / what to do, opening-hours confidence, honest source labels and an optional mini-route.

get.summary: Current user; guests get 200 {"user": null} (no 401 noise in the browser console)

schema.title: Response Me Api Auth Me Get

delete.summary: Delete my account and all my data

schema.title: Response Saved List Api Me Saved Get

post.summary: Set a new password with a reset token
Recommendations around a known place recognised in a photo (multipart form)
post.description:
The photo is decoded with a pixel cap, stripped of EXIF (GPS is never read), downscaled to 1024 px and
re-encoded before the LLM picks a place from a closed list; nothing is stored.

image.description: JPEG / PNG / WebP, up to 8 MB

landmark.description: Optional fallback landmark key if the photo is not recognised

get.summary: POIs around a point for the map (brief)

schema.title: Response Api Pois Api Pois Get

post.summary: Report outdated info (closed, wrong hours). Stores only aggregated counters.

usage.description: Tokens and estimated cost of all LLM calls of this request

cost_usd.title: Cost Usd
cost_usd.description: Estimated USD from the price table in config; null = unknown model price

lat.title: Lat
lat.description: Latitude; the client should round to 3 decimals (~100 m)

lon.title: Lon
lon.description: Longitude; the client should round to 3 decimals

password_reset_email.title: Password Reset Email
password_reset_email.description: SMTP is configured: password reset by email works

label.title: Label
label.description: Human text in the response language, e.g. «Открыто до 22:00 (данные OSM)»

raw.title: Raw
raw.description: Original OSM opening_hours string, if any

next_change.title: Next Change
next_change.description: Local HH:MM of the next open/close change, if known

recognized.title: Recognized
recognized.description: True when a known place was identified confidently enough to search around it

place_id.title: Place Id
place_id.description: Landmark key (GET /api/meta) or POI id the photo shows

description.title: Description
description.description: Short description of the photo by the AI

ideas.title: Ideas
ideas.description: AI-generated micro-activities (source=generated), anchored to a recommended place

considered.title: Considered
considered.description: A few places that were rejected and why (transparency)

off_topic.title: Off Topic
off_topic.description: The query is not about places/walks in Astana: no recommendations, see notes

query.title: Query
query.description: Free text in RU/KK/EN, e.g. «Я возле Байтерека, хочу погулять час» (long text is truncated)

lang.title: Lang
lang.description: UI language; null = detect from the query

location.description: Approximate user position (rounded). Server rounds again.

landmark.title: Landmark
landmark.description: Landmark key or name from GET /api/meta instead of GPS

time_budget_min.title: Time Budget Min
time_budget_min.description: Total time the user has (null = from text or 60)

profile.description: Team contract §3.3 profile (with_kids, tourist, accessibility, group_size)

with_child.title: With Child
with_child.description: Overrides profile.with_kids; null = detect from text

want_route.title: Want Route
want_route.description: Ask for a 2–3 stop mini-route (default: auto)

now.title: Now
now.description: ISO datetime override for tests, e.g. 2026-10-18T19:30:00+05:00

weather.description: Weather override for tests (null = live Open-Meteo)

refine.title: Refine
refine.description: Follow-up refinements of the previous request: closer, no_coffee, indoor

ideas.title: Ideas
ideas.description: AI-generated micro-activities (source=generated), anchored to a recommended place

considered.title: Considered
considered.description: A few places that were rejected and why (transparency)

off_topic.title: Off Topic
off_topic.description: The query is not about places/walks in Astana: no recommendations, see notes

poi_id.title: Poi Id
poi_id.description: POI id (osm:w123 / wd:Q123 / ov:...) or idea-N for AI ideas

distance_m.title: Distance M
distance_m.description: Straight-line (haversine) distance from the start, metres

travel_min.title: Travel Min
travel_min.description: Travel minutes along the real street network (walk) or road estimate (car)

source.title: Source
source.description: poi_data = collected dataset; generated = AI idea

source_url.title: Source Url
source_url.description: Exactly the dataset source (OSM / Wikidata / Wikipedia page) or null

rating.title: Rating
rating.description: Always null in v1: no open rating source exists for Astana

website.title: Website
website.description: The place's own website, if known

category_detail.title: Category Detail
category_detail.description: Fine-grained category key (33 types), see GET /api/meta

walk_distance_m.title: Walk Distance M
walk_distance_m.description: Network walking distance (car: estimated road distance)

leave_by.title: Leave By
leave_by.description: HH:MM to leave this place to keep the user's deadline (flight etc.)

data_sources.title: Data Sources
data_sources.description: Where the facts come from: osm, wikidata, wikipedia, overture, ticketon, sxodim

popularity.title: Popularity
popularity.description: 0..1 proxy from Wikipedia/Wikidata signals and data richness

features.title: Features
features.description: Confirmed amenities in the response language (Wi-Fi, terrace, ...)

badges.title: Badges
badges.description: indoor, outdoor, kids, hidden_gem, event, popular, night, free

description.title: Description
description.description: Short description (Wikipedia extract or facts from tags)

total_min.title: Total Min
total_min.description: Travel + visits (+ return leg if returns_to_start)

now.title: Now
now.description: ISO datetime used for opening hours (Astana, UTC+5)

parsed_from_query.title: Parsed From Query
parsed_from_query.description: What the system understood from the text (categories, needs, deadline)

funnel.title: Funnel
funnel.description: POIs total -> within reach -> after filters -> shown

max_outdoor_min.title: Max Outdoor Min
max_outdoor_min.description: Comfortable continuous minutes outdoors derived from feels-like/wind

WeatherOverride.title: WeatherOverride
WeatherOverride.description: Test override of live weather (reproducible evaluations).
